title: Manchester United's Nico Paz chase: judge the window, not the rumour
body:
Manchester United are reportedly targeting Como midfielder Nico Paz as their new manager, Mauricio Pochettino, is set to receive backing in the transfer market [S2].

The wider coverage shows how crowded the market is. BBC Sport's gossip column also linked Besiktas with a move for Amad Diallo and reported that Barcelona plan to resist offers for Alejandro Balde [S1]. Chelsea are also said to be targeting Kounde [S2].

Across their last five league matches they have won none, drawn three and lost two, collecting three points while scoring six and conceding 11 [ST1]. The sequence reads draw, draw, defeat, defeat, draw [ST1]. A side with that defensive record needs more than one glamorous name to turn things around.

Still, the cautious view is the better one. A club in this position is tempted to sign a headline player quickly to show progress.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
